title: Verify: Real store defaults and each action unit tests
summary: Consolidated tests for defaults and all five actions of the real store
description: Write game/frontend/tests/uiStoreReal.test.ts importing the real store and asserting defaults, double toggles and modal open/close, with state reset in beforeEach.
acceptance_criteria: Given reset state, when read, then defaults and five function actions are asserted.
Given each toggle twice, when read, then flip then restore is asserted with other fields unchanged.
Given openModal then closeModal, when read, then 'contribution' then null.
technical_constraints: Real store only; no browser or server
definition_of_done: Test file passes via its own command

steps.action: Create the file importing { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest' and { useUiStore } from '../src/store/uiStore'; beforeEach calls useUiStore.setState(useUiStore.getInitialState(), true). Add test 'default state' asserting drawerOpen false, modal null, soundEnabled true, settingsOpen false and typeof toggleDrawer/openModal/closeModal/toggleSound/toggleSettings === 'function'.
steps.code: it('default state', () => { const s = useUiStore.getState(); expect(s.drawerOpen).toBe(false); expect(s.modal).toBeNull(); expect(s.soundEnabled).toBe(true); expect(s.settingsOpen).toBe(false); expect(typeof s.toggleDrawer).toBe('function'); });
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/uiStoreReal.test.ts -t 'default state'

steps.symbol: new: it('each toggle flips and restores')
steps.action: Add a test calling toggleDrawer, toggleSound and toggleSettings once each and asserting drawerOpen true, soundEnabled false, settingsOpen true; call each again and assert drawerOpen false, soundEnabled true, settingsOpen false; assert modal stays null throughout.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/uiStoreReal.test.ts -t 'each toggle'

steps.action: Add a test calling openModal('contribution') and asserting modal 'contribution' with drawerOpen still false, then closeModal() and asserting modal null.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/uiStoreReal.test.ts
steps.expected: All tests in the file pass.
